document.title: Patel Lab — Vaccine Uptake by Zip Code and Income Level: Chicago Pilot Analysis
document.source: CPHD Community Health Equity Lab — Internal Working Dataset v3 (not peer reviewed)
document.ambi_context: Zip code targeting data for mobile vaccine clinic rollout pitch — Children's Hospital Foundation meeting

metadata.study_population: Residents aged 6 months and older, Chicago metro zip codes, 2023–2025
metadata.exposure_definition: Vaccine uptake = % of eligible residents with up-to-date vaccination status per zip code
metadata.outcome: Proportion unvaccinated or under-vaccinated (<37 weeks gestation)
metadata.note_on_60628: Roseland (60628) zip code — major community clinic closed mid-data-collection in Oct 2024; uptake figures reflect a supply disruption, not underlying demand

uptake_by_zip.note: Consistent low uptake across 2023–2025 data collection window
Second highest unvaccinated rate; stable across collection window

⚠ Primary community clinic closed Oct 2024 mid-collection. Elevated unvaccinated rate likely reflects access disruption, not stable underlying demand. Do not anchor pilot justification on this figure without flagging.
Consistent high unvaccinated rate; stable and strong candidate for pilot

conservative_anchor.rationale: CI lower bound for Garfield Park — holds even if minor data cleaning shifts the central estimate. Stable across full collection window. Suitable for pilot justification without caveats.
conservative_anchor.james_note: This is the number that survives scrutiny with highest probability. Roseland looks more dramatic but the foundation board will ask questions we can't answer cleanly yet.

key_finding.summary: Lowest-income zip codes show consistently high unvaccinated rates — 38–44% in stable estimates. The Roseland figure (52%) is an outlier driven by a clinic closure, not a reliable signal of underlying need.
key_finding.policy_implication: Pattern supports targeting Little Village, Garfield Park, and West Englewood for the first three mobile clinic placements. Roseland should be flagged as a future phase once the clinic access situation is resolved.
